skills.name: jinja-partials
skills.description: Reusable HTML fragments for Jinja2 templates in Flask, Quart, FastAPI, Starlette, or any Jinja2 environment, through a render_partial() template global that renders a fragment file with explicitly passed data and nests freely. Use when adding jinja_partials or jinja-partials to an app, writing or refactoring templates that repeat markup, serving HTMX fragments, choosing between include, macro, and render_partial, or when a partial renders as escaped text, raises PartialsException or TemplateNotFound, or a FastAPI or Starlette route fails with "asyncio.run() cannot be called from a running event loop".
